caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with decorative carvings. The box is colored in varying shades of reddish-brown, giving it a natural wood appearance. The surface of the box is adorned with symmetrical, intricate carved patterns that include stylized leaf and floral motifs. The front panel of the box shows three prominent carved shapes resembling leaves or fronds radiating outward, surrounded by spiky and star-shaped decorations. The top surface continues the theme with more floral and geometric motifs carved into the surface. The right side of the box displays a single large, swirling design bordered by a spiked edge. The drawing is rendered against a light, neutral background, and the artist's inscription “MAJEL G. CLAFLIN - TAOS.” appears in small text in the lower left corner.
title: Box
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
